Hi Marissa,

We're kicking off the SIG assessment for the upcoming procurement window and my security team requested a handful of items related to incident response so we can complete the tooling and controls section:

- Current Incident Response (IR) playbook (any redacted/PII-safe copy is fine)
- Recent IR tabletop or test summary (past 12 months)
- Sample auth/log extract (no full PII; just a few lines to validate retention and schema)
- Confirmation of our RTO/RPO expectations and notification SLAs

Can you confirm whether those artifacts are available and whether we need an NDA or controlled transfer? If possible we'd like to review by next Wednesday (6/3) to stay on the procurement timeline.

Thanks — Elena

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the request; assigning items below with notes about transfer controls.

1) IR_Playbook_Redacted_v2.pdf — attached to this thread (redacted for customer identifiers and internal account names). This is our operational playbook covering detection, escalation matrix, comms templates, and postmortem steps.

2) IR_Test_Summary_2025-11.pdf — attached. High-level outcomes from our Nov 2025 tabletop, including RTO observations and a list of remediation actions.

3) auth_log_sample.csv — attached, contains schema and 20 redacted lines. No PII. If you require a larger dataset for schema validation, we will need to complete an evidence transfer addendum (link below).

4) RTO/RPO and notification SLAs — we target 99.9% availability for our hosted endpoints with near-real-time alerting to on-call. Typical notification windows:
   - First acknowledgment: within 15 minutes of a confirmed alert during business hours (on-call 24/7)
   - Customer notification (if customer-impacting): within 1 hour for high-severity incidents

Transfer controls and a small administrative ask: for access to forensics-level exports we require a signed platform evidence addendum (this is standard for larger data pulls). I've opened a DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/12345-FT — if you can sign that, we'll send the rest.

Drive links (view-only with download disabled where required):
- IR package: https://redwood-drive.example.com/s/IR_Playbook_Redacted_v2

If a call makes sense, I'm available Mon 6/1 10:00-11:30 PT or Tue 6/2 13:00-15:00 PT.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
